hypothesis: A small shared wrist follow-through can provide missing downward displacement while bounded thumb preparation/release coordination and a small forward translation preserve simultaneous D3 and front-edge palm clearance.

root_parameters.pivot: approved semantic wrist origin, not native-transform Empty origin
root_parameters.curve: All three offsets multiplied by original D2 depression fraction. Original quintic35ms down/70ms return. One shared root; no NOTE_ON teleport.

joint_policy.little: Exact inherited full trajectory, no new little solve.
joint_policy.idle_three: Exact inherited L1 rotations; passive shared-root motion only.
joint_policy.thumb: Convex blend of old thumb rotations toward approved L1 thumb preparation, per-joint blend coefficient between0 and1. Coefficient linear in original D3 key depression, multiplied by D2 key depression. Eight coefficients over entire sequence, no per-frame IK.

hard_bounds_deg.meaning: Flexion1/2/3 then base spread. Increment from already curved RSSF rest; not global anatomical joint angles.

continuity.near_bound_dwell: MEASURE_ONLY; no independent .05s rejection. No contortion to meet old dwell threshold.

contact.target: Inherited registered static contact point transported with actual key

solver.method: One deterministic bounded least_squares in Blender, all geometry from dependency graph; no manual skinning
solver.collocation: All original120Hz contact samples, plus preparation/recovery quarter points. Duplicate invariant joint/key states reused only within same residual call.

scope: Only left full micro sequence 0.4–1.8 seconds. Static scenes retained. No production promotion or full Musette.
naturalness: Human-visible precheck and Human approval still required.
